title: Looks Nothing Like The Pictures
text: Looks Nothing Like The Pictures. I wanted to love this. I really did. I collect skulls, they're all over the house. I saw the pictures in the product listing and just had to have it, plus it was on sale, then it arrived. Whoever photographed this did an amazing job of making thin, cheap, extremely fragile, plastic that is a pale comparison to the product listing's images. The gold doesn't shine the green doesn't look like jade. It looks like something you could pick up for a couple bucks at a bargain store. . . and likely in a year or so that's where these will be found. They couldn't even include an ornament hook which can be had for less than half a cent each. Hallmark used to sell a quality product across the board. Very disappointed in this item. Three stars only because I really like skulls. It really deserves two.
